text: Cole will fight to safeguard and expand the civil rights and liberties of all people against modern threats.

Delivering clean drinking water and protecting the natural beauty of the St. Croix Valley region are among our community’s dearest values. Our candidate will build bridges between conservationists, local governments, and landowners to champion responsible stewardship.

Families are being crushed by sky-high costs of living, including essentials like housing and healthcare. Cole Birkeland is focused on building bridges at the Capitol to secure real, lasting relief for working people so that everyone can have a fair shot to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

Our high-achieving schools must be focused on good outcomes, not divisive agendas. We must build bridges between parents and educators to ensure our kids are equipped for citizenship and vocation in order to flourish in school and beyond.
